name: ga-formation
description: Form and keep in good standing a Georgia LLC or corporation, or register a foreign entity to do business in Georgia, in 2026. Covers the Secretary of State eCorp filing, the fees from 6 September 2025 ($100 plus a $10 service charge for articles, $50 plus $10 for the annual registration, $225 plus $10 for a certificate of authority), the corporation's notice of intent to incorporate in the county legal organ, the first annual registration (within 90 days for a corporation, January to 1 April of the next year for an LLC), the $25 late penalty, administrative dissolution and the $250 reinstatement, professional corporations, and the Department of Revenue and Department of Labor tax registrations that follow. Trigger on "form an LLC in Georgia", "Georgia articles of organization", "Georgia annual registration", "Georgia certificate of authority", "Georgia notice of incorporation".
